description: Starts a draft or paused campaign on your person's order, as Start campaign does: it enrolls the people waiting; messages marked Sergio sends then go out on their own in the send window under the business's Sending setting, and the rest are drafted for a person to send. First call without confirm_token: nothing changes; you get a preview (every message's exact words, how many people it reaches now, the audience rules, and whether the business's Sending lets a person's messages go out) and a confirm_token. Show your person the preview word for word, and only after they say yes, call again with the same arguments and the SAME idempotency_key, plus confirm_token. If the preview says Sending is switched off, tell your person that plainly with the link; only the owner turns it on, in Sergio, and you never change it. Messages marked Sergio sends need no send call. To send the drafted (person-sent) messages, use send_campaign_messages later, in a separate turn once they are in Ready to send: never in the same set of changes as this start, because its first drafts are written after the start answers. Before the campaign exists, pass create (create_campaign's arguments) instead of campaign_id: nothing runs, and you get the same preview with a confirm_token; after create_campaign with exactly those arguments, call with its campaign_id, the same create and that confirm_token, and it starts only if its preview is still word for word what was shown.

confirm_token.description: From the preview, after your person said yes. Leave it out to get the preview.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: start_campaign
title: Start a campaign (after your person confirms)
